d:
Daya, who was on her way to Ahmedabad to search for Sundarlal, runs into him disguised in a fake beard and mustache. Sundar brings her back home and begs her to keep his hideout secret until 12:00 PM on Holi, insisting he did nothing wrong.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
